identity.title: [v0.92][runtime-v3][20.c1] Add Linux service control to CSMctl

values.goal: Make the merged CSMctl launcher work safely on Linux while preserving Darwin behavior.
values.required_outcome: start_CSM.sh and CSMctl provide tested start, stop, restart, and status control on native Linux without invoking launchctl, while issue #268 retains authority for the native x86 Amazon Linux AWS qualification.
authority_boundary: Issue #268 owns the paid AWS qualification
operator_constraints: Gemini must review the exact implementation head before merge
